intro: Type an amount and see it in Omani Rial, Bangladeshi Taka, US Dollar and other Gulf currencies at once. The amount is also written in words, and Taka uses lakh and crore.
Have a rate from your exchange house, bank or app? Use your own rate to see exactly how much you will get.
steps: Choose the currency you have and the one you want.
Optional: enter your exchange house rate.
Read the result, in numbers and in words.

faq.a: No. The rates are set by arafatbin.com and the update date is shown under the converter. Banks, exchange houses and apps use their own rates and fees, so use your own rate for the exact amount.

faq.q: Why is the Omani Rial rate almost the same every day?
faq.a: The Omani Rial is pegged to the US Dollar at about 0.3845 Rial per Dollar, so it hardly changes. The Saudi Riyal, UAE Dirham, Qatari Riyal and Bahraini Dinar are pegged too. The Bangladeshi Taka is not.

faq.q: Can I see the amount in Bangla digits?
faq.a: Yes. Turn on Bangla digits under the result.
